message.content:
```python
import os
import dd4hep
from dd4hep import kernel, importConstants, Geant4, setupUI, setupTrackingField, setupTracker, setupGun, setupPhysics, PhysicsList

# Initialize kernel
dd4hep_kernel = kernel()

# Load geometry from XML file in DD4hepExamplesINSTALL
geometry_path = os.path.join(os.environ['DD4hepExamplesINSTALL'], 'DDDetectors/compact/Tracker.xml')
dd4hep_kernel.loadGeometry(geometry_path)

# Import constants from detector description
importConstants(dd4hep_kernel.detectorDescription())

# Set up Geant4 instance with tracker
g4 = Geant4(dd4hep_kernel)
setupTracker(g4)

# Configure user interface
setupUI(g4)

# Configure tracking field
setupTrackingField(g4)

# Configure event actions
from dd4hep.simulation import EventAction, TrackingAction, SteppingAction, RunAction, StackingAction
g4.addUserInitialization(EventAction())
g4.addUserInitialization(TrackingAction())
g4.addUserInitialization(SteppingAction())
g4.addUserInitialization(RunAction())
g4.addUserInitialization(StackingAction())

# Set up particle gun: gamma, 5 keV, multiplicity 1
setupGun(g4, particle='gamma', energy=5e-3, multiplicity=1)  # energy in MeV

# Set up tracker
setupTracker(g4)

# Set up physics list and add particle groups/processes
physics = PhysicsList('FTFP_BERT')
physics.addPhysics('em')
physics.addPhysics('decay')
physics.addPhysics('hadron')
physics.addPhysics('ion')
g4.addUserInitialization(physics)

# Execute Geant4 instance
g4.execute()
```
